notes: Arm deltas are added to the current joint-position targets (command history, not the measured pose) and clipped to joint_limits_rad, which are the intersection of the MJCF joint range and actuator ctrlrange. The gripper command is absolute: normalized -1 maps to gripper_closed_rad and +1 to gripper_open_rad, and its target moves by at most gripper_max_delta_per_step_rad per step. Any clip is recorded as status 'clipped' with the applied normalized action; the requested action is never altered. Scales are powers of two so the arm channels round-trip exactly in float32.
